gloss: senior in age; older; the eldest

definitions.gloss: senior in age; older; the eldest
definitions.explanation: Being older than others, or a person who is older. Used both as a noun and, with の, as a modifier. The opposite of {年少|ねんしょう}.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{私|わたし}より{年長|ねんちょう}だ。
{年長|ねんちょう}の{人|ひと}を{敬|うやま}う。
グループの{中|なか}で{一番|いちばん}{年長|ねんちょう}なのは{彼女|かのじょ}だ。
examples.english: She is the oldest one in the group.

notes:
Being older in age, or the older person; the opposite of {年少|ねんしょう}. Works as a noun and, with の, as a modifier.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年長|ねんちょう}{者|しゃ}: an elder; a senior person
- {年長|ねんちょう}の{人|ひと}: an older person
- {一番|いちばん}{年長|ねんちょう}: the eldest

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {年上|としうえ}: older — the everyday word, always relative to another specific person
- {年少|ねんしょう}: younger; junior — the antonym
